existing_noise_cleanup_limitations: Global -4<Z<170 filtering excludes extreme returns but is not a ground/noise classifier.
Maximum-per-bin rasterization promotes isolated high returns and blends roofs, trees and facades.
3x3 median filtering blunts roof ridges and slender landmarks; nearest filling can propagate errors across unmeasured areas.
No withheld filtering, statistical outlier removal, robust roof-plane segmentation or footprint-constrained cleanup appears in build_surface.py.
The derived terrain retains roofs; it cannot be imported as the craterable bare-earth surface.
Imagery-derived green/water/canopy masks are artistic heuristics and carry unresolved Esri derivative-use rights.

osm_footprints.probe_status: Succeeded; public geography query only, response processed in memory and not retained as a source-data file
osm_footprints.query_method: GET with URL-encoded data parameter; POST form data also supported
osm_footprints.query_bbox_order: south,west,north,east in WGS84; approximately 800m core plus 50m halo and slight projection-envelope excess
osm_footprints.coverage_interpretation: Enough mapped polygons for the first patch. This is not proof of exhaustive coverage, correct footprints, relation validity or 946 independent buildings. Geometry/member overlaps and parts remain to be normalized.
osm_footprints.capture_mismatch: OSM snapshot is September 8, 2026; LiDAR is March 26, 2015. Current footprints may represent new/demolished buildings and roof tags are sparse.
download_recipe: Run the recorded bounded query once; retain response bytes, timestamp, query, attribution and a locally computed SHA-256 in a NEW generated-data directory. To request the same historical snapshot, add date=2026-09-08T16:38:10Z using Overpass date syntax and verify that the endpoint supports attic data.
Reject HTTP errors, XML/HTML error bodies, a JSON remark, timeout or a truncated response. Honour 429/504 and do not start parallel retries or download a country/planet extract.
Use out body geom without an output bbox so selected ways and relation members retain full geometry; fetch only missing relation members if required, with a hard object-count/extent cap.

Exclude building=no/building:part=no and construction/abandoned/demolished states unless explicitly modeled as such. Preserve OSM type/id, relation member roles, source tags and the acquisition timestamp.

Assemble multipolygons with outer/inner rings; suppress duplicate member-way buildings and overlapping parent shells when detailed building:part volumes cover them. Treat non-multipolygon building relations as grouping metadata rather than a polygon.

Keep whole buildings intersecting the core if they fit within the halo. If a footprint extends beyond the 50m halo, defer it or obtain a specifically bounded extension; do not manufacture an open building at the patch edge.

legacy_projection_recipe.request: Transform the four corners of [315189,233593,316789,235193] from EPSG:29903 to EPSG:3857 with always_xy=True; request encompassing bbox, bboxSR=3857, imageSR=3857, size=2048,2048, format=jpg, f=json
legacy_projection_recipe.returned_extent_is_authoritative: Use assets\imagery-georeference.json, not an assumed request bbox: the server fits the requested aspect ratio.
legacy_projection_recipe.resampling: For each destination pixel centre transform legacy Irish Grid to EPSG:3857; source col=(mx-xmin)/(xmax-xmin)*2048-0.5; source row=(ymax-my)/(ymax-ymin)*2048-0.5; scipy.ndimage.map_coordinates(order=1, mode=nearest).
legacy_projection_recipe.ue_image_uv: u=(E-315189)/1600; v=(235193-N)/1600, top-origin V. In proposed UE coordinates: u=0.5+Xcm/160000; v=0.5+Ycm/160000.
legacy_projection_recipe.image_precision_caution: 0.78125m/px is resampled output spacing, not guaranteed native imagery resolution or ortho accuracy. JPEG does not embed the working georeference; keep sidecar metadata.
legacy_projection_recipe.appearance: This is aerial/satellite basemap colouring for roofs and ground. Oblique roof lean, cast shadows, occlusion, temporal mismatch and image resampling preclude facade survey fidelity.

first_patch_reconstruction.recommendation: Footprint-constrained, roof-preserving per-building solids on a newly separated ground surface; do not convert the monolithic snowglobe heightfield into fracture geometry.
first_patch_reconstruction.status: Implementation recipe and tunable starting thresholds, not an executed reconstruction
recognition_anchors: OSM-confirmed Trinity Old Library/Campanile and Liberty Hall footprints
first_patch_reconstruction.background_extent: Existing 760m-radius disc is useful only as a visual/reference extent. It is not clean destructible architecture and includes unlicensed-for-UE imagery. Outside surveyed coverage do not imply a measured city.
first_patch_reconstruction.bounded_processing: Begin with cached core/halo rasters. For roof or ground failures, stream only needed source tiles in chunks and discard points outside the halo immediately. Ordinary LAZ is not a COPC spatial index, so a tiny XY crop can still require decoding much of a tile; schedule that separately, never reread all 1.2B points here.

steps.name: Normalize footprints
steps.method: Reproject with the frozen legacy CRS contract; assemble multipolygons and holes; remove only duplicate vertices/zero-length edges; make invalid rings valid with explicit diagnostics. Preserve courtyards and non-orthogonal architecture. Start with 0.25m topology-preserving simplification, maximum 0.5m, rejecting changes above 2% area or collapsing narrow parts/shared boundaries. These are proposed tolerances, not validated fit quality.

steps.name: Establish ground independently of roofs
steps.method: Exclude all footprint interiors plus a small buffer, vegetation, water and elevated bridge decks from candidate ground samples. Fit a robust local ground surface from supported low, smooth road/courtyard samples; propagate beneath buildings with an explicit support-distance/confidence mask. Prefer a robust 3-10m external ground ring and a local plane over taking terrain at the building centroid. Reject disconnected rooftop terraces even when class 2. Preserve river banks and separate decks; do not interpolate a road bridge across the river bed.

steps.name: Fuse measured roof heights
steps.method: Use valid, sufficiently populated cells inside footprint eroded initially by 1m, retaining the un-eroded boundary for silhouette. Start with >=30 valid interior samples and >=70% measured interior coverage; small buildings need a separately flagged path. Fit connected robust roof planes with an initial 0.35-0.75m residual band and report residual/support, rather than using the global maximum. Raw-point refinement should reject withheld/nonfinite/isolated points, use local height distributions and geometric planarity, and retain coherent steep/vertical landmark returns. Classes 2/4 alone do not distinguish buildings from vegetation.

steps.name: Retain roofs and distinguish eaves from ridges
steps.method: Clip fitted planes to the real footprint and building:part boundaries; intersect adjacent planes to retain supported ridge/hip lines. Roof height at each boundary creates wall tops; base follows the independently fitted ground. Do not set every roof vertex to p95, erase all roofs with a morphological filter, or let unconstrained Delaunay triangles bridge courtyards. Use constrained triangulation over each clipped roof region. For complex/unresolved roofs retain a constrained denoised local height patch, or explicitly downgrade that building to a tagged coarse model. OSM roof tags guide but do not override contradictory measured roof evidence.

steps.name: Handle gaps and date conflicts explicitly
steps.method: Prefer coherent LiDAR roof evidence. OSM height/min_height can support a flagged fallback after units are validated; building:levels alone is not a measured height and needs an explicitly labeled assumed storey height. If neither sufficient LiDAR nor usable tags exist, flag/defer the building instead of silently inventing a height. Modern footprints without matching 2015 roof massing are change-detection conflicts, not interpolation targets. Keep confidence, source snapshot and chosen method per building.

steps.name: Create closed fracture-ready solids
steps.method: One closed mesh per resolved building volume: roof, exterior walls, courtyard-facing walls and triangulated underside/foundation cap with matching rings. Courtyard holes must remain real holes through the footprint. Add a modest explicitly artificial foundation depth below local terrain (initially 1m), not the display plinth. Resolve overlapping parts into non-overlapping closed volumes; do not overlay a parent shell on its parts. Weld compatible boundaries, remove zero-area triangles, orient outward, and require two incident faces per edge, no self-intersections and positive enclosed volume. Validate disconnected components separately; a manifold mesh alone is not enough to guarantee robust fracture.

steps.name: Separate materials and surfaces
steps.method: Apply only cleared aerial/orthophoto RGB to roof and ground XY UVs. Use explicitly generic facade materials with metric UVs; do not stretch top-down imagery down walls or claim measured windows. Keep water, bridge decks, vegetation, landmarks and ground as independent layers. Remove roof massing from the ground before placing solids, preventing duplicate surfaces and buried phantom buildings.

steps.name: Package for the next UE stage
steps.method: Generate geometry offline, keeping double-precision survey coordinates until local-origin subtraction. Store per-building IDs/pivots, geometry, UVs, confidence and provenance alongside a common transform. Prefer local per-building vertices plus world placement metadata. Produce native static meshes using an approved editor-side importer or export interoperable static-mesh files in a separate stage. No full-dataset runtime reconstruction, Unreal mutation, API inspection or fracture implementation occurred in this recovery.

first_patch_reconstruction.landmarks: Preserve the Spire as a separate intentional tapered solid: source script base H=6.45m, tip H=124.609m, base diameter 3m; tip radius 0.08m in real scale. These dimensions are recovered from prior code, not independently surveyed here. Do not confuse the raster's blunted 85.182m sample with the restored tip.
first_patch_reconstruction.terrain_and_water_future_boundary: The cleaned ground is a starting height surface, not an implemented runtime crater system. Heightfields cannot represent arbitrary caves/overhangs; river bed/bathymetry is not established by this LiDAR/aerial data. Water H=1.1m in the snowglobe is an artistic constant, not a measured tide. Keep hydrology and bridge structure work separate.

ue_import_contract.target: UE5.8 DublinFlight; not modified or built
ue_import_contract.preferred_route: Data-first static-mesh reconstruction from normalized footprints and fitted roofs. Do not import all snowglobe objects or run build_globe.py as an import step.
ue_import_contract.direct_mesh_builder_route: Convert positions by coordinate_contract.ue_from_survey, reverse source winding for the reflected Y basis, transform normals, then subtract per-building UE pivot from vertex positions and place its actor at that pivot. This avoids hidden interchange axis/scale conversions.
ue_import_contract.interchange_route: Export selected/generated geometry only, explicit centimetre units and declared axes, separate building objects, no globe/base/studio/air/snow/combined canopy. Configure exporter and UE importer so the final transform equals the recorded matrix exactly once; leave final actor scale and import uniform scale at 1 after units are baked. Preserve material slots and UVs; avoid combining all buildings. A specific Blender 5.2 FBX preset was not run or verified, so do not rely on undocumented default axis conversion.
ue_import_contract.legacy_blend_reference_only: If extracting a reference mesh from BLEND in a later dedicated read-only load/copy, evaluate object world transforms first, remove +0.132 display lift, restore 100 surveyed metres per Blender unit, then convert metres to cm. The direct combined factor is 10000, not 100; importer unit conversion may account for part of it, so do not apply it twice.
required_import_acceptance: Labelled east/north/up calibration vertices land exactly at the specified cm positions; 100m is 10000cm and north is negative UE Y in this proposed basis.
Spire XY offset is [-8550,-27950]cm; bridge remains XY zero; no 13.2m display lift remains.
Top surfaces face up with backface culling enabled; reflection did not invert normals or double-flip winding.
A known roof/ground corner aligns in both geometry and top-down UVs; distinguish top-origin image V from Blender bottom-origin V.
Core spans 80000cm per horizontal dimension; actor scale is 1 and buildings remain separately addressable.
Closed-solid topology, self-intersection checks and confidence diagnostics pass before any destructive-fracture conversion.

performance_intent.recommendation: Keep 800m patch bounded; validate one 100-200m block before expanding. Chunk static ground around 100m with LODs, instance vegetation, simplify distant buildings and use modest texture mips. Proposed 2m cleaned-ground sampling gives 401x401 vertices / 320000 triangles across the core, before chunk borders/LOD. Keep fracture activation, debris limits, crater updates and water effects local and separately budgeted in the later stage.
performance_intent.limitation: Neither triangle counts nor laptop GPU branding prove >=60FPS. No engine, destruction, thermal/power or memory profiling was performed. Rendering the original 3.63M-triangle city plus display scene is not a valid destruction-performance proxy.
